## Build and run on Xbox
- With your Xbox in Dev Mode, **Build → Build for Xbox → Windows & Xbox app** has **Build and run on Xbox**: Ignite3D builds the package with your Visual Studio (Universal Windows Platform workload), installs it on the console through Device Portal and starts it.
- Enter the console's IP address and the Device Portal user name and password from Dev Home → Remote Access, then press **Connect**. The password stays in memory until Ignite3D closes.
- Each console build gets the next version number, so it installs over the last one and keeps the game's saves. **Build package** makes the sideload package without installing it.
- Ignite3D remembers the console's security certificate and sends nothing to a console whose certificate has changed until you press **Trust this console**.
- The Xbox app uses the TV's full 1920×1080, keeps the controller on the game (B no longer leaves it), plays sound without a click, opens links outside the game and can host online games on your network.
- Claude can build and run the game on the console too, once you've connected in the dialog.

## Linux and macOS
- This release has the Linux AppImage and the macOS app (Apple silicon and Intel), which were missing from the 2.18.0 release. **Help → Check for Updates** keeps them up to date.
